searchText: Hello! Currently working on implementing the eth2apis into Prysm, are the APIs currently stable, and if not, is there any estimate on when they will be? Hey all! Is it possible for me to get the current slot number from the Eth2 HTTP API? AFAICT, `/eth/v1/beacon/headers/head` (https://ethereum.github.io/eth2.0-APIs/#/Beacon/getBlockHeader) returns the current head block, which is not necessarily from the current slot An easy way would be to instead fetch genesis https://ethereum.github.io/eth2.0-APIs/#/Beacon/getGenesis `curr_time - genesis_time / slot_time` And you would get your current slot. In mainnet `slot_time` would be 12 seconds Gotcha, that solves the problem! Thanks! 🙂 > Hello! Currently working on implementing the eth2apis into Prysm, are the APIs currently stable, and if not, is there any estimate on when they will be? <@!118185622543269890> Nearly. There are a few outstanding PRs, but any further PRs _should_ be around clarification of the spec and its interaction rather than changes to functionality.

excerpts.author: adiasg
excerpts.content:
Hey all! Is it possible for me to get the current slot number from the Eth2 HTTP API? 
AFAICT, `/eth/v1/beacon/headers/head` (https://ethereum.github.io/eth2.0-APIs/#/Beacon/getBlockHeader) returns the current head block, which is not necessarily from the current slot

excerpts.author: nishant0
excerpts.content:
An easy way would be to instead fetch genesis 
https://ethereum.github.io/eth2.0-APIs/#/Beacon/getGenesis
`curr_time - genesis_time / slot_time` And you would get your current slot. In mainnet `slot_time` would be 12 seconds

excerpts.author: adiasg
excerpts.content: Gotcha, that solves the problem! Thanks! 🙂
